meaning:
περί-λυπος, -ον
[in LXX: Psa.42:5, 11, I Est.8:69, al. ;]
very sad, deeply grieved: Mat.26:38, Mrk.6:26 14:34, Luk.18:23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
